moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday this Friday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Birthday Shout-Out
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia and chart domination! Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa this Friday. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Dance Floor Anthem
angles.copy: She's bringing the heat to the dancefloor and turning 31! Get ready to celebrate Dua Lipa's birthday with us all week. Which track gets you moving?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins on Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Hype
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for glory, and who's in for a shocker on opening weekend?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: After 25 years, Coventry City are back in the Premier League! They face champions Arsenal in their opener this Friday. What a welcome to the top flight!

moments.title: All Points East Festival
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival returns to Victoria Park, London, from August 21st to 30th, featuring a diverse lineup of artists.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is taking over Victoria Park from Friday! Who's heading to London for some epic live music?

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: If you're in London this weekend, All Points East is THE place to be. Tag a mate you're dragging along!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival in Dorset
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz, club culture, soul, hip hop, and electronica, takes place in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20th-23rd.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Fun
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset this Thursday! Four days of incredible music, wellness, and good vibes. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: It's officially SOLD OUT! We Out Here Festival is bringing the best in jazz, club culture, and more to Dorset from August 20-23. Lucky ticket holders, enjoy!

moments.title: Trentham Live 2026
moments.blurb: Trentham Live brings a series of open-air concerts to The Trentham Estate in Staffordshire from August 20th-23rd.

angles.name: Staffordshire Sounds
angles.copy: Trentham Live starts this Thursday! Get ready for a weekend of amazing open-air gigs at The Trentham Estate. Who are you excited to see?

moments.title: Shambala Festival
moments.blurb: The independent and sustainable Shambala Festival runs from August 27th-30th, promising 'Adventures in Utopia'.

angles.name: Utopian Adventures
angles.copy: Shambala Festival is just around the corner, August 27-30! Get ready for four days of music, art, and sustainability. Who's joining the adventure?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals will host thousands of music fans from August 28th-30th across both sites.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: It's almost time for Reading & Leeds! Who's heading to one of the biggest festivals of the summer from August 28-30?

angles.name: North vs South
angles.copy: Reading or Leeds? Which festival are you hitting up for the Bank Holiday weekend? Let us know your lineup highlights!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is still in full swing, running until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: The Edinburgh Fringe is still buzzing with incredible shows and performances! If you're up in Scotland, don't miss out before August 31st.

moments.title: New Music & Chart Battles
moments.blurb: The Official Singles Chart update for August 16-22 shows KATSEYE aiming for a Top 10 debut, a new Madonna & Kylie collaboration, and Fontaines D.C. releasing a new single.

angles.name: Chart Race
angles.copy: Who's going to dominate the charts this week? KATSEYE are eyeing a Top 10 debut, plus new tracks from Fontaines D.C. dropping tomorrow!

angles.name: Pop Icons Unite
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is in the Top 10! The ultimate pop collaboration is making waves. What a track!

angles.name: Fontaines D.C. New Single
angles.copy: Get ready, Fontaines D.C. fans! Their new single 'Marianne' is out tomorrow. What are your expectations for this one?

moments.title: Sam Fender's Longest-Running Number One
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made history as the longest-running UK number-one single of all time, with 21 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Making History
angles.copy: A massive congratulations to Sam Fender and Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is now the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever. What an achievement!

moments.title: New UK TV on BritBox
moments.blurb: BritBox is premiering new British dramas this week, including 'Cooper & Fry' (August 17) and 'Vanity Fair' (August 19).

angles.name: Mystery Monday
angles.copy: Fancy a new crime drama? 'Cooper & Fry' premieres on BritBox today! Perfect for those moody Peak District vibes.

angles.name: Period Drama Alert
angles.copy: If you love a classic, 'Vanity Fair' arrives on BritBox this Wednesday. Get ready for some fierce ambition and 19th-century drama!

moments.title: Celebrity MasterChef Returns
moments.blurb: A new batch of famous faces enters the kitchen as 'Celebrity MasterChef' returns to BBC One and iPlayer on Tuesday, August 18th.

angles.name: Kitchen Chaos
angles.copy: Who's ready for some culinary chaos? Celebrity MasterChef is back on BBC One tomorrow night! Who do you think will impress John and Gregg?

moments.title: Professor T Series 4 Premieres
moments.blurb: Ben Miller returns as the eccentric criminologist in 'Professor T' Series 4, premiering on ITV1 and ITVX on Wednesday, August 19th.

angles.name: Criminology Genius
angles.copy: Professor T is back! Series 4 of the brilliant crime drama starts this Wednesday on ITV1. Are you ready for more Jasper Tempest?

moments.title: Late Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Late Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend and the traditional date for Notting Hill Carnival.

angles.name: Long Weekend Countdown
angles.copy: Who's already planning their Late Summer Bank Holiday weekend? Just two weeks to go until that glorious extra day off!

angles.name: Notting Hill Carnival
angles.copy: The Bank Holiday weekend means one thing in London: Notting Hill Carnival! Get ready for the vibrant celebrations on August 30th & 31st.

moments.title: UK Weather: Rain and Thunder Ahead
moments.blurb: After a dry spell, the Met Office forecasts more unsettled weather for the UK this week, with rain, showers, and a risk of thunder.

angles.name: Rain Is Coming
angles.copy: Grab your brollies! The Met Office is forecasting a change in the weather this week, with rain and even a risk of thunder in some areas. How's it looking where you are?
